title: Business Central Under the Hood episode 1: Developing AI in Business Central

chapters.title: Introduction to the Under the Hood series
From web technology to AI: Michael's journey
AI features in Business Central: marketing text and chat
Testing fuzzy inputs and outputs with LLMs
Chain of Thought reasoning and prompt engineering
Copilot service architecture and chat orchestration
Jailbreaking prevention, meta-prompting, and AI toolkit
Azure OpenAI Studio and prompt development tools

features.name: Marketing text generation
features.description: AI feature that generates marketing text based on keywords for items in Business Central.
features.status_evidence_quote: we have released at least marketing text where we can kind of generate the marketing text based on kind of keywords for for

features.name: Chat Copilot for Business Central
features.description: A chat interface inside Business Central that helps guide users, provides help on navigating the product, and allows asking questions about data and records.

features.name: Bank reconciliation with LLM
features.description: AI feature that uses large language models to match bank records in the bank reconciliation process.

features.name: AI developer toolkit
features.description: A toolkit for developers to create customizations in Business Central using large language models and leveraging OpenAI power.

features.name: Few-shot learning prompting technique
features.description: A prompt engineering technique where the LLM is shown examples of input and expected output so it learns what is wanted without detailed explanations.
caveats: easily specify formatting like JSON or XML

features.name: Chain of Thought prompting
features.description: A prompt engineering technique where the LLM breaks down problems into smaller steps, similar to how humans think, by instructing it to reason step by step.

features.name: Copilot service architecture
features.description: A cloud-based service that runs in Business Central clusters with a chat pane in the client communicating back to the service. It includes an orchestrator component to manage multi-turn conversations and a plugin service for skill management.

features.name: Chat orchestration
features.description: A component that manages multi-turn conversations, keeps track of chat history, extracts context, and determines which skills or plugins the LLM needs to use to get additional information.

features.name: Function calling
features.description: A prompting technique where the LLM is given function definitions and parameters, and tells the user which functions to call with what parameters to answer a question. The LLM does not execute code but guides the user on what needs to be done.
caveats: LLM does not execute code, only provides guidance on what to call

features.name: Hallucination prevention through data feeding
features.description: A technique to prevent LLM hallucinations by always feeding the LLM with up-to-date information and instructing it in the prompt to only use provided data to answer questions, preventing it from making up information.
caveats: LLMs are eager to provide answers even without correct information

features.name: Content moderation and jailbreaking prevention
features.description: Built-in content moderation systems and filtering that remove harmful content and prevent jailbreaking attempts. Techniques include content filters from Azure OpenAI services and meta-prompting with instruction sets about what not to do.
caveats: New jailbreak techniques come up all the time
Some filters have become permanent and cannot be turned off

features.name: Meta-prompting technique
features.description: A set of instructions at different places in the prompt that specifies what the LLM really should not do, such as harmful content or violence. Has proven hard to jailbreak but remains subject to new jailbreak techniques.
caveats: New jailbreak techniques emerge over time

features.name: AI toolkit for partners and developers
features.description: A toolkit being released for partners and developers to get started with LLMs and AI. Includes API components in AL and UI elements that ship with the product, helping provide consistent experience similar to native features.
caveats: User must be kept in the loop, cannot let it run by itself

features.name: Azure OpenAI Studio
features.description: A useful tool on Azure for constructing and testing prompts with immediate turnaround, allowing developers to refine prompts and experiment with different techniques without writing extensive code around it.
